newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Bancshares buys 5 BankAmerica units.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Bancshares buys 5 BankAmerica units.

text.p: International Bank of Commerce, the lead bank for International Bancshares Corp, said on Thursday that it definitively agreed to buy five bank branches in Texas from Bank of America Texas, a subsidiary of BankAmerica Corp.
The terms of the deal were undisclosed. The transaction is expected to close in early 1997, the banks said.
International Bank of Commerce said the acquisitions in Angleton, Freeport, Lake Jackson, Rosenberg and Texas City bring its network of banks to more than 50 in 18 Texas communities.
The five branches are the last of 68 branches that Bank of America said in June it would sell. Bank of America Texas has more than 1,900 branches in 10 states and assets of about $241 billion.
